top_signals.title: Retailers say extended peak shipping season winding down
top_signals.summary:
NRF says the extended peak shipping season is winding down, with most holiday merchandise already in and U.S. container imports expected to ease through year-end.

The post Retailers say extended peak shipping season winding down appeared first on FreightWaves.

top_signals.title: Beaten Down Loans from Proofpoint, Sophos Climb as AI Fears Ease
top_signals.summary: A series of leveraged loans recently sold by software companies are climbing as investor fears about the industry ease and lenders that couldn’t originally buy the debt snatch it up.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: PepsiCo Raises €1 Billion Just One Day After Cutting Outlook
top_signals.summary: PepsiCo Inc. returned to Europe’s market for publicly syndicated bonds for the second time this year, raising €1 billion ($1.12 billion) just a day after cutting its profit outlook on mounting costs in North America.

top_signals.title: Cable One Lender Seeks to Block $480 Million Mega Broadband Deal
top_signals.summary: Lender CoBank ACB filed a lawsuit Friday seeking to block Cable One Inc. from acquiring a 55% equity stake in Mega Broadband Investments from private equity firm GTCR.
